prompt: React vs Vue: which should I learn first?

plan.title: React vs Vue: Which to Learn First?
plan.description: A quick look at React and Vue and how to pick one as your first front-end framework. Learn which suits beginners and which opens more doors.

beats.narration: React or Vue? Everyone argues about it, but for your first framework, the honest answer is simpler than you think.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: Vue feels gentle. Its structure is clear, and beginners often get something working fast. React is bigger, with more jobs and more learning resources.
beats.speaker: narrator

beats.narration: Want jobs? Start with React. Want a smooth first step? Pick Vue. Either way, the concepts transfer, so just choose one and build.

props.text: Pick one. Build something. The skills transfer.

beats.speaker: narrator
